title: Application of Metagenomics in Food Analysis: Unraveling the Microbial World of Fresh Produce, Poultry Products, and Meat
content: Metagenomics has revolutionized the study of microbial communities, enabling researchers to explore the complex and diverse ecosystems present in various environments, including food products. This review provides an overview of the recent advancements in metagenomic techniques applied to food analysis, highlighting their potential for enhancing food safety, quality, and understanding of food microbiomes. The use of metagenomics in food analysis has significantly expanded our knowledge of the microbial diversity and functional potential of edible products, shedding light on the interactions between food components and the microbiota. This review highlights the growing importance of metagenomic approaches in food analysis and emphasizes the potential implications for food safety, quality, and preservation. It also showcases the wide range of studies that have utilized metagenomics to unravel the hidden microbial world of edible products. However, the field of metagenomics in food analysis is continuously evolving, and future research is expected to bring even more exciting discoveries and applications to the food industry. Challenges and perspectives of this novel approach are also considered.
